_note: Product family catalogue for template authoring. Stage blueprints are STRUCTURE ONLY. No tolerances/specs are defined here: every parameter must come from an Engineering-controlled checklist (as AXIS came from Axis_Final.xls) and be published by the Quality Manager. Sources: tiglobal.com, globaldryers.com, coconutmachineryindia.com product listings.

inspection_types.name: Final inspection (pre-despatch)
inspection_types.when: Before despatch; releases MO in Odoo

inspection_types.name: Factory acceptance test
inspection_types.when: Dryers and lines: trial run before despatch

inspection_types.name: Site acceptance / commissioning
inspection_types.when: Turnkey projects after installation; offline capture needed

stage_library.COMP: Component and bought-out verification (make, rating, qty, serial)
stage_library.FAB: Fabrication and welding (dimensions, weld visual, DP test where specified)
stage_library.SS: Food-contact surfaces (material grade cert, finish, weld polish, cleanability)
stage_library.HEAT: Heating system (radiator/heat exchanger, burner/HAG, thermic fluid or steam circuit)
stage_library.PRES: Pressure and leak tests (hydrostatic / pneumatic / refrigerant)
stage_library.ELEC: Electrical and controls (panel, IR, earthing, interlocks, PLC/HMI, VFD)
stage_library.RUN: Trial run / performance (no-load, load, temperature profile, throughput)
stage_library.DOCS: Documents and tools kit (manuals, certificates, spares, tools list)
stage_library.LINE: Line integration (interfaces between machines, conveyor transfer, sequencing)
